items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: started writing with Artie... Artie went to Boston... Artie said, 'When you're gonna write for me?'... I did 'Back Bay' for Artie and 'Traffic Jam' for Artie.

ctx.x: That was like when Artie Shaw was there (and I (inaudible)) started writing with Artie. I think it was in '37 or '38. Working for (inaudible) both bands. Artie went to Boston and Chick Webb was in Boston, (inaudible) LaVodges.
